All The Asian Stars At Spring/Summer 2027 Fashion Week

The season’s most fabulous fashion moments, courtesy of Asia’s hottest celebs.

By Larissa Wong - published 15 Sep 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:27
Instaread

Fashion month is officially in motion, and Asia’s biggest stars are taking their seats. From K-pop idols and Korean actors to Thai entertainment favourites and fashion’s newest faces, the front rows of New York, London, Milan and Paris are set to be just as star-studded as the runways themselves.

First stop, New York Fashion Week. We’re rounding up the Asian stars commanding attention from the front row, from their runway-show appearances to the standout looks that had everyone talking. As the fashion circus packs up and rolls on to London, Milan, and Paris, expect this list to grow—along with a parade of celeb fashion moments you won’t want to miss.

Related article: The A-Z Of Thai Brand Ambassadors

Calvin Klein

Lingling Sirilak Kwong is THAT girl, and she proved it at her first Calvin Klein show. The star greeted hundreds of screaming fans before heading to see the brand’s spring 2027 show. As for her look, Lingling kept it understated and classy with an all-black ensemble featuring a velvet blazer with a deep V-neck and matching trousers.

ADVERTISEMENT

After Sea Tawinan Anukoolprasert’s steamy Calvin Klein Underwear campaign, all eyes were on the star to serve looks—and he totally understood the assignment. For his very first fashion week appearance, Sea turned heads with a pinstriped suit and a white shirt, barely buttoned.

Tommy Hilfiger

It’s not fashion week without a BLACKPINK member making headlines everywhere! Tommy Hilfiger brand ambassador and K-pop icon Jisoo made her fashion week appearance dressed in a white logo-adorned t-shirt, a short-sleeved navy varsity jacket and a dark denim mini skirt.

Three times the heartthrobs, three times the charm! Tommy Hilfiger brand ambassadors and Thai actors Fourth Nattawat Jirochtikul, Phuwin Tangsakyuen and Gemini Norawit Titicharoenrak stole the show with their dreamy visuals and star power.

ADVERTISEMENT

For the show, Fourth opted for a white shirt, striped tie and white trousers with a black leather jacket layered over. His co-star, Gemini, went for a more laid-back look with a grey hoodie, varsity jacket, and black trousers. Last but not least, Phuwin went for a preppy look with a blue button-up, cream-coloured V-neck sweater and blue jeans. Where is Pond Naravit Lertratkosum? While the fellow actor and ambassador couldn’t attend this season, all four boys starred in a cute video to make sure Pond got in on the fun too!

Did someone say triple threat? Girls’ Generation members Hyoyeon, Yuri, and Sooyoung, also known by their newly-formed sub-unit name Girls Generation HRS, took on fashion week in coordinating ensembles. In true bestie fashion, the trio matched in navy blue blazers and trousers.

Singer and host Eric Nam looked preppy in a striped quarter zip sweater, white trousers and black loafers.

ADVERTISEMENT

It’s giving K-drama boyfriend. Jung Hae-in, aka the leading man of viral K-drama Our Sticky Love, looked dapper in a white shirt and tie, a burgundy varsity jacket and dark denim jeans.

Chinese singer Yosh Yu looked suave in a light blue shirt and tie, paired with crisp white trousers and a wool coat.

Related article: The A-Z of Korean Brand Ambassadors

Tory Burch

New fashion darling alert? It’s the girl of the hour, tennis player Alexandra Eala, making her New York Fashion Week debut. For the occasion, Alex kept things classy and cute with a fitted red button-up blazer and tan trousers.

Celebrated K-drama actress Gong Hyo Jin was a vision in red at the Tory Burch spring/summer 2027 show. The screen queen wore an oversized red midi dress and nude peep-toe pumps.

Related article: All The Must-Know Celebrity Campaigns Of 2026

Coach

Thai it girl Love Pattranite Limpatiyakorn loves to serve a look. The actress made her New York Fashion Week debut in a daring ensemble: a black bralette, an oversized houndstooth blazer, and a black denim midi skirt.

Thai actor Nanon Korapat Kirdpan took on the big city in style with a basic black tee, oversized black jeans, a distressed brown leather jacket, and a slouchy suede bag.

Soyeon, rapper, producer and leader of i-dle, looked like a total girl boss in a striking red shirt and trouser co-ord. She completed the look with long, wavy locks and a black shoulder bag.

K-pop girl group KiiiKiii has finally made their fashion week debut—at Coach’s 85th anniversary spring 2027 runway show, no less! The girls embraced their new era *wink wink* in coordinating fits that feature star motifs, striped patterns and matching bags.
